chunks: Before mentioning those who were emissaries during the period of occultation, we will mention some reports about those who were specifically assigned to each Imam and managed his affairs, in a concise manner,
and we will mention those among them who were praised for their good method, and those who were condemned for their poor creed, so that the situation may be known in that regard.
ai.seo_question: Who were the special deputies of the Imams during the occultation and how were they evaluated?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi structures this introduction to establish the criteria for evaluating the reliability of the Four Emissaries (al-Sufara al-Arba'a) and other deputies during the Minor and Major Occultations. By categorizing them into those praised for their sound methodology (hasan al-tariqa) and those condemned for doctrinal errors (si' al-madhhab), he provides a historical framework for distinguishing authentic leadership from false claimants. This distinction is crucial for understanding the transition of authority and the preservation of Shia orthodoxy during the Imam's absence.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: Before we begin discussion about the Special Deputies of the Imam during the period of occultation, we would mention some reports in brief, which are restricted to each of the Imams and which are related to the management of their affairs.

In the same way, we will also mention reports about those who were praised and who followed the right path as well as those who were condemned and who did not follow a right faith, so that we may become conversant with the circumstances of their lives.
